description: List an app's, agent's, or skill's releases, newest first: each one's version, state, commit, and when it was created, and which one is active. A release that never went live is not listed. To roll back, read an earlier release's files with get_source and its release argument, then publish them again. A skill's release version is the version get_skill reports, and get_skill with release returns that release. Websites are refused. Requires connecting a Valet account.

limit.description: How many releases to return, newest first.

name.description: The app's, agent's, or skill's name.

org_name.description: The Valet organization it belongs to. Omit to use the organization the account joined first.

name: list_releases

kind.description: Kind of the service: app, agent, or skill.

name.description: Name of the app, agent, or skill.

org.description: Name of the Valet organization the call acted in.

releases.description: The newest releases that went live, newest first, at most limit of them.

active.description: True for the newest active release, the one the service runs now.

commit.description: The Git commit the release was built from. Absent for a release that predates commits.

created_at.description: When the release was created, as an RFC 3339 time.

state.description: The release's state. Only releases that went live are listed, so this reads active.

version.description: The release's version. Pass it as release to get_source or, for a skill, get_skill.

total.description: How many releases the service has that went live. More than the length of releases when limit cut the list.

title: List releases
